svg.title: Fan out the what
svg.desc: The root splits a thesis into three questions; Demand splits its own; updates climb one level; the person asks for status; the idle root steers a drifting child.

text.tspan: The person asks the root. The root splits the what into three independent questions.
Each child does its own how with tool calls (the dots). The root isn't blocked; it's idle.
Demand splits its own question in two. Their updates go to Demand, not to the root.
Mid-run, the person asks for status. The root answers from its children's updates.
An update shows Expression drifting. The idle root steers it with a note.
Each decision goes to whoever asked for it. Demand folds in its two before reporting.
The root decides from three answers and replies. The trail is the tree of decisions.
